description: Documentation reference only; does not alter task selection or success predicates.

tasks.name: BoilCorn
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Place both pieces of corn from the plate into the saucepan. Then place the lid on the saucepan to start boiling the corn.
tasks.success_summary: Both corn pieces in the saucepan; saucepan on the selected active burner; lid on saucepan; far(lid).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Current tolerances: burner distance < 0.15 m, lid receptacle threshold 0.05 m; burner starts on.

tasks.name: BreadAndCheese
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Place the bread and cheese on the cutting board.
tasks.success_summary: Both food objects on the cutting board; far(obj), the first food object.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Checks the first food object's hand distance, not both food objects.

tasks.name: CheesyBread
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Pick up the wedge of cheese and place it on the slice of bread to prepare a simple cheese on bread dish.
tasks.success_summary: Bread remains on its cutting board; cheese contacts bread; far(cheese).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Atomic in this release. Bread starts on a cutting board and uses scale 1.5.

tasks.name: ChooseMeasuringCup
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Open the {left/right} drawer and place the {larger/smaller} measuring cup on the counter.
tasks.success_summary: Selected cup contacts the counter, other cup does not; far(selected cup).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Drawer closing is not part of this task's success predicate. Fresh G1 MJCF uses the selected drawer-side robot anchor.

tasks.name: CleanBlenderJug
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Take the blender jug and place it in the sink to prepare it for cleaning.
tasks.success_summary: Jug inside the sink; far(jug).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Placement prepares for cleaning; no washing or water-flow requirement.

tasks.name: CloseDishwasher
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Close the {dishwasher} door.
tasks.success_summary: Dishwasher fixture reports is_closed(env).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Shared door-task predicate; fixture-specific closure threshold.

tasks.name: CloseElectricKettleLid
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Close the lid of the electric kettle.
tasks.success_summary: Normalized electric-kettle lid state <= 0.01.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Lid position only; no kettle activation requirement.

tasks.name: CloseFridge
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Close the {fridge} {door/doors}.
tasks.success_summary: Fridge fixture reports is_closed(env).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Door wording depends on the sampled fridge; placement is fridge-type dependent.

tasks.name: CloseFridgeDrawer
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Fully close the fridge drawer.
tasks.success_summary: Fridge-compartment drawer at index -1 passes is_closed(th=0.05).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: SonicG1 default initial offset: 0.05 m backward in the robot frame.

tasks.name: CloseOven
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Close the {oven} door.
tasks.success_summary: Oven fixture reports is_closed(env).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Shared drop-down-door task; fixture-specific closure threshold.

tasks.name: CloseStandMixerHead
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Close the stand mixer head.
tasks.success_summary: Normalized mixer-head state < 0.01.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Head closure only; mixing is not required.

tasks.name: CloseToasterOvenDoor
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Close the toaster oven door.
tasks.success_summary: Toaster oven reports is_closed(env).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Door state only; rack motion is a separate task.

tasks.name: CoffeeServeMug
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Pick the {mug} from under the coffee machine dispenser and place it on the counter.
tasks.success_summary: Target object contacts the counter; far(object).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Uses machine_to_counter behavior; no brewing requirement.

tasks.name: CoolBakedCake
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Take the baked cake out of the oven and place it on the plate for cooling. Then close the oven door.
tasks.success_summary: Cake on plate; plate contacts counter; oven closed; far(cake).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: No temperature or elapsed cooling-time test.

tasks.name: DrawerCakeSort
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Open the drawer, place both cakes inside it, then close the drawer.
tasks.success_summary: Both cakes inside the drawer and off all counters; far(each cake); drawer closed.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Included in the 15 seen composites. Both cakes sample a 0.15 m-deep outer-edge band. Fresh G1 MJCF uses the selected drawer-side robot anchor.

tasks.name: DryDishes
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Pick the cup and bowl from the sink and place them on the counter for drying.
tasks.success_summary: Cup and bowl contact the target counter; far(each).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: No moisture or elapsed drying-time test.

tasks.name: DumpLeftovers
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Dump the {leftovers} from the bowl so the bowl can be washed. Place the bowl in the sink after clearing the leftovers.
tasks.success_summary: Both leftover1 and leftover2 outside the bowl; bowl inside sink; far(bowl).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Both leftovers are checked independently; earlier revisions repeated the leftover1 test.

tasks.name: LoadDishwasher
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Pick up the {cup} and {bowl} from the counter, place them in the dishwasher, and close the dishwasher door.
tasks.success_summary: Both dishes contact the top rack; dishwasher door closed at th=0.05.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Door/rack start open/out; dish sampling shifts 0.15 m left; bowl scale 0.5. Door closure is required.

tasks.name: NavigateKitchen
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Navigate to the {target fixture}.
tasks.success_summary: Horizontal distance to target base placement <= 0.25 m and yaw cosine >= 0.98.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: SonicG1/SonicG1Fixed use pelvis (base fallback); other robots use mobilebase0_base.

tasks.name: OpenDishwasher
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Open the {dishwasher} door.
tasks.success_summary: Dishwasher fixture reports is_open(env).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Shared drop-down-door predicate; fixture-specific opening threshold.

tasks.name: OpenDrawer
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Open the {left/right} drawer.
tasks.success_summary: Every normalized joint position returned for the drawer is >= 0.95.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Target drawer side comes from episode initialization; fresh G1 MJCF uses the matching robot anchor.

tasks.name: OpenFridge
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Open the {fridge} {door/doors}.
tasks.success_summary: Fridge fixture reports is_open(env).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Door wording depends on the sampled fridge; placement is fridge-type dependent.

tasks.name: OpenFridgeDrawer
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Fully open the fridge drawer.
tasks.success_summary: Fridge-compartment drawer at index -1 passes is_open(th=0.70).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Targets the internal drawer, not the external door.

tasks.name: OpenToasterOvenDoor
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Open the toaster oven door.
tasks.success_summary: Toaster oven reports is_open(env).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Door state only; rack motion is a separate task.

tasks.name: PackDessert
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Add the {dessert} to the tupperware that contains the {cooked food}.
tasks.success_summary: Cooked food and dessert in the same target tupperware; far(dessert).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Atomic in this release. Tupperware scale is (2.5, 2.5, 1.25); cooked food starts inside.

tasks.name: PickPlaceCounterToOven
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Place the {object} on the {top/bottom} rack of the oven.
tasks.success_summary: Object in oven tray; tray contacts the selected rack; far(object).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Top/bottom wording is omitted for a single-level oven.

tasks.name: PickPlaceCounterToSink
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Pick the {object} from the counter and place it in the sink.
tasks.success_summary: Object inside sink using partial_check=True; far(object).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: The implemented containment check explicitly allows partial containment.

tasks.name: PickPlaceCounterToStandMixer
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Place the {object} in the stand mixer bowl.
tasks.success_summary: Mixer check_item_in_bowl(object) passes; far(object).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: No head-closure or mixer-activation requirement.

tasks.name: PickPlaceCounterToStove
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Pick the {object} from the plate and place it in the {pan}.
tasks.success_summary: Object in target pan with receptacle threshold 0.07 m; far(object).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: SonicG1 explicitly places the source container on the counter's front side.

tasks.name: PickPlaceStoveToCounter
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Pick the {object} from the {source container} and place it {in/on} the {target container}.
tasks.success_summary: Object in target container with receptacle threshold 0.07 m; far(object).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Success does not separately test target-container contact with the counter.

tasks.name: PortionPeaches
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Place one peach from the bowl on each plate.
tasks.success_summary: Exactly one of the two peaches on each plate; far(each peach).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Canonical G1 task replaces PortionHotDogs: two peaches, two plates, bowl scale (1.5, 1.5, 1).

tasks.name: ServeWarmCroissant
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Take out the warm croissant from the {top/bottom} rack of the toaster oven and place it on the plate.
tasks.success_summary: Croissant on plate; far(croissant).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Single-level ovens omit rack level; no door-reset or heat-state requirement.

tasks.name: ShakePan
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Grip the pan handle, lift and shake it lightly to move the {vegetable} inside the pan. Place the pan back down on the stove once finished.
tasks.success_summary: At least 25 qualifying movement updates; vegetable in pan; pan on selected active burner within 0.15 m.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Movement update means pan displacement > 0.001 m while food is inside; no grasp/lift test.

tasks.name: SlideDishwasherRack
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Fully slide the top dishwasher rack {out/in}.
tasks.success_summary: Normalized top-rack position >= 0.95 for out, or <= 0.05 for in.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: SonicG1 default initial offset: 0.50 m left in the robot frame.

tasks.name: SlideToasterOvenRack
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Fully slide the toaster oven {top/bottom} {rack/tray} {out/in}.
tasks.success_summary: Selected-level movable rack/tray position >= 0.95 for out, or <= 0.05 for in.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Instruction follows fixture rack/tray type and level; level is omitted when not applicable.

tasks.name: StackBowlsInSink
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Stack the bowls in the sink.
tasks.success_summary: Both bowls inside sink; either bowl in the other; far(each bowl).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Either stacking order is accepted.

tasks.name: TiltPan
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Tilt the pan slightly to move the {vegetable} inside the pan. Place the pan back down on the stove once finished.
tasks.success_summary: At least 12 updates with quaternion-derived angle > 0.3 rad and food inside; food remains in pan; pan on selected active burner within 0.15 m.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: The final predicate does not impose a separate return-to-level angle threshold.

tasks.name: TurnOnToaster
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Push down the lever of the toaster to turn it on.
tasks.success_summary: turned_on is true for the slot touching the bread, falling back to slot 0.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Checks the toaster's state, not toast color or elapsed heating time.

tasks.name: TurnSinkSpout
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Turn the sink spout to the {left/right}.
tasks.success_summary: Sink spout_ori equals the requested behavior.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Spout direction only; no water-flow requirement.

tasks.name: WipeTable
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Pick up the sponge from the counter and wipe the counter by gripping it and pressing it against the surface. Once finished, release the sponge.
tasks.success_summary: At least 5 grasped counter-contact positions >= 0.02 m apart, bounding-box diagonal >= 0.10 m, then far(sponge, 0.15 m).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Dex3 grasp helper uses hand-object contact instead of Panda finger-position comparisons.

tasks.name: CupcakeCleanup
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Move the fresh-baked cupcake off the tray onto the counter, and place the bowl used for mixing into the sink.
tasks.success_summary: Cupcake contacts target counter; bowl inside sink; far(cupcake) and far(bowl).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Unseen composite; both final placements must hold together.

tasks.name: PastryDisplay
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Place the pastries on the plates.
tasks.success_summary: Two pastries on different plates, either assignment; far(each pastry).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Unseen composite; plate assignment is interchangeable.

tasks.name: BoilEggs
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Place both eggs from the plate into the saucepan with boiling water.
tasks.success_summary: Both eggs in saucepan; saucepan on selected active burner; far(saucepan).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Unseen composite; uses stove helper's 0.08 m default burner threshold.

tasks.name: PrepareBroilingStation
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Pick up the tongs from the counter and place them near the plate next to the oven.
tasks.success_summary: Tongs and plate each contact a counter; their XY distance < 0.30 m; far(tongs).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Fresh samples require XY separation >= 0.40 m before settling; same-counter placement remains allowed. Success predicate unchanged.

tasks.name: BreadSetupSlicing
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Place all breads on the cutting board.
tasks.success_summary: Every sampled bread on the board; far(obj_0) only.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Unseen composite; num_bread is stored in episode references; no slicing test.

tasks.name: ClearCuttingBoard
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Clear the non-vegetable object off the cutting board and place the vegetables onto it.
tasks.success_summary: Both vegetables on the board; non-vegetable off the board; far(board).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Unseen composite; the distance check targets the board, not each moved object.

tasks.name: OrganizeVegetables
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Place the {vegetable 1} and the {vegetable 2} on separate cutting boards.
tasks.success_summary: Vegetables on different cutting boards, either assignment.
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Unseen composite; no hand-distance condition in this predicate.

tasks.name: DessertAssembly
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Place the {container} with {dessert} and the cupcake onto the tray.
tasks.success_summary: First dessert remains in its container; that container and cupcake on tray; far(tray).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Unseen composite; preserves the nested dessert/container relationship.

tasks.name: MeatSkewerAssembly
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Move the kebab skewers from the plate to the oven tray for oven preparation.
tasks.success_summary: Both skewers on oven tray; tray contacts dining counter; far(each skewer).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Unseen composite; oven insertion or cooking is not required.

tasks.name: RotatePan
tasks.instruction_example_or_template: Rotate the pan to help distribute the heat more evenly.
tasks.success_summary: Pan has exceeded 15 degrees of yaw change from its first check; pan contacts stove; meat remains inside; far(pan).
tasks.g1_or_release_note: Unseen composite; rotation is latched, so the final yaw need not remain beyond 15 degrees.
